messages.subject: Pick a fall 2016 meeting time!
parts:
Greetings D-Ruggers!  

It's almost time to re-convene the Davis R-Users Group meetings for fall quarter!  Please help us out by completing this really short poll.

We're trying to figure out the best structure for meetings in order to serve our users, so especially if you're new to the group, we'd love to have your input.

Thanks!  Looking forward to seeing everyone again soon!
Myfanwy Johnston & Michael Levy
(your 2016 Co-Coordinators)

Myfanwy Johnston
Ph.D Candidate, UC Davis
Animal Behavior Graduate Group
